description: 新竹科學園區管理局道路挖掘及占用管理 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 國家科學及技術委員會新竹科學園區管理局. 年/月份，維修及道路管理：道路申請開挖審查、核准道路許可證、道路申請占用審查，供追蹤道路挖掘占用管理統計。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 國家科學及技術委員會新竹科學園區管理局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
